annotations.title: Update Subscriber Tags, Unsubscribe, or Bulk Import Subscribers

description: Assign or remove audience segment tags on a subscriber device (subscriber_id), permanently unsubscribe a device (unsubscribe=true), or bulk-import existing Web Push subscribers via CSV or JSON array (import_app_id + import_csv or import_subscribers) at 0 credit cost. Use this tool to manage subscriber segmentation, remove a device, or migrate subscribers from OneSignal/LaraPush/Webpushr; do not use it to list or export subscribers (use list_subscribers instead). Requires PUSHNOTIF_API_KEY and costs 0 credits. Returns JSON { ok, subscriber_id, action, tags, removed, imported, updated }.

add_tags.description: Optional list of lowercase segment tag strings (e.g., ['vip', 'jakarta']) to attach to the subscriber for targeted broadcasts

import_app_id.description: Optional target app_id (app_xxxx) when performing a zero-downtime bulk subscriber import via import_csv or import_subscribers

import_csv.description: Optional CSV text containing endpoint,p256dh,auth,tags rows to bulk-import into import_app_id

import_subscribers.description: Optional JSON array of subscriber objects ({endpoint, p256dh, auth, tags}) to bulk-import into import_app_id

remove_tags.description: Optional list of segment tag strings to remove from the subscriber

subscriber_id.description: Target subscriber device ID in format sub_xxxx (required when updating tags or unsubscribing a single device)

unsubscribe.description: Set true to permanently unsubscribe and delete this subscriber device record

name: update_subscriber_tags
